target.ordinal_id_warning: Layer ordinal IDs in the (layers) block are NOT physical order: (0 F.Cu, 3 In3.Cu, 1 In1.Cu, 2 In2.Cu, 4 In4.Cu, 31 B.Cu). Physical order is the (setup (stackup ...)) sequence recorded above. Do not map F.Cu/B.Cu by alphabet or ordinals.

HV.note: Mains-referenced / switched power. Isolation barrier to SELV required across every copper layer; a declared boundary or distance check alone is not a barrier (CONCEPTS.md).

SELV_LV.note: Aux 15V from PS1 (IRM-10-15, isolated) feeds buck VIN; buck 3V3 feeds MCU VCC3V3. Power_in.gnd ~ power_out.gnd inside BuckConverter3V3 is the single LV return tie for this section.

signal.note: SELV-referenced control/sense. No new HV/LV crossing is introduced by this section.

mcu.note: Current target placeholder for the MCU. U2 replaces its geometry with the P1 source-derived package; identity is revalidated then, not by refdes match here.

buck.note: Current target placeholder for the buck. Surrounding passives near (100-145, 135-160) are NOT blanket-attributed; U2 binds each to BuckConverter3V3 source instances (c_in/c_boot/l_out/c_out1/c_out2/c_out_hf/r_fb_top/r_fb_bot) before any removal.

mcu_block.purpose: MCU module + decoupling/EN/boot/I2C pullups + routing access

antenna_keepout.purpose: ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 antenna access: no copper pour, tracks, or tall parts; keep clear on all copper layers. RF certification itself is out of scope.

buck_block.purpose: Buck converter local loops (input, switch, output, feedback) + inter-block supply/return exits

reserved_regions_mm.note: Regions are reservations for P1 construction and P3 U2/U3 routing, not a full product floorplan (out of scope per plan).

mechanical.keepouts_observed: 10 copper-pour keepout polygons exist in the target; none is an antenna keepout. Antenna keepout above is newly reserved by this context.

reconciled_contradictions: Ordinal layer IDs (0/3/1/2/4/31) do not encode physical order; resolved to the setup/stackup sequence F/In3/In1/In2/In4/B with thicknesses above.
Two-layer buck prototype settings (50x40mm, 1.6mm FR-4, 1oz, HASL) do NOT transfer; target is six-layer 164x234mm ENIG above.
Prototype J1/J2/TP1-TP4/H1-H4 are fixtures, excluded from the functional nine (U3/L2/C9/C10/C11/C12/C13/R16/R17).
Samsung capacitor update (CL32B106KBJZW6E / CL32B226KAJNNWE) postdates older receipts; U2 uses current bytes via source-manifest, not a copied digest.
Net-name spellings (+3V3 vs 3V3, gnd vs GND) are aliases resolved by canonical source identity in U2, not by string match.

remove.reason: MCU placeholder replaced by P1 source-derived package
buck IC placeholder replaced by source-matched LMR51430 geometry
buck inductor placeholder replaced by source-matched SRP1265A-5R6M geometry

replacement_ledger.verify_then_remove: Target passives inside buck_block/mcu_block that U2 binds to a BuckConverter3V3/MCU source instance; each removal must verify the object existed in the baseline and retain before/after identity.
replacement_ledger.retain: All geometry outside the owned boundary envelopes; shared +3V3/gnd nets are cut only at envelope endpoints, never deleted by net name.
replacement_ledger.boundary_rule: Cut/reconnect shared or crossing nets only at explicit envelope endpoints with continuity rechecked after insertion. A crossing that cannot be replaced within scope is a named interface blocker (interfaces.json), not permission to reroute unrelated circuits.

pending_inputs.p1_combined_source: P1 U2 wrapper/export (buck+MCU through 3V3/return) — required before U2 composition
pending_inputs.p1_mcu_geometry: P1 U4 accepted pcb/blocks/mcu/ package — required before U2 composition
pending_inputs.p2_memory_closeout: Needed only for U4 handoff, not for U1 context

provenance.extraction: native KiCad file parse (outline gr_poly, setup/stackup, layers, nets, footprints); no Python rotation or net-identity policy introduced
